items.title: BOUND: Brief-Guided Corrective Preference Distillation at Search-Control Boundaries
items.title_zh: BOUND：搜索控制边界上的简报引导式纠偏偏好蒸馏
items.summary: BOUND targets persistent drift in LLM deep-search agents by having a teacher construct a search-state brief at student decision points and decide whether to form a corrective or termination preference pair, which DPO then distills into the student. It leads on five of six rerun benchmarks and 12 of 14 metrics, beating Trajectory SFT by 5.6 EM on Bamboogle and 4.8 accuracy points on BrowseComp-Plus.

items.title: Integrated Multimodal AI System for Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning, Object Sensing, and Damage Analysis
items.title_zh: 面向检索增强推理、目标感知与损伤分析的集成多模态 AI 系统
items.summary: The work presents a unified multimodal damage-assessment system combining retrieval-augmented language models grounded in project documentation, infrared/thermal sensing, vision foundation models and exploratory wireless signal sensing. Controlled comparisons show dynamic retrieval improves grounding over static few-shot prompting and graph-based retrieval helps cross-document queries.

items.title: AquiLLM: An Architecture for Supporting Tacit Knowledge Capture in Research Groups
items.title_zh: AquiLLM：支持研究团队隐性知识捕获的架构
items.summary: AquiLLM is an open-source modular RAG-LLM framework built on open-weight models to help research groups capture tacit knowledge. The described upgrades add local embedding and reranking, multimodal capabilities, OpenAI-compatible inference, semantic and episodic memory, and skills support, informed by discussions with astrophysicists and environmental researchers.

items.title: Improving Generalization Robustness of Multimodal RLVR
items.title_zh: 提升多模态 RLVR 的泛化鲁棒性
items.summary: The authors trace brittle multimodal RLVR gains to a binary verifier that conflates format with content and a training distribution narrower than deployment prompts, and propose Prompt-Invariant RLVR with a dynamic trinary reward and an embedding-space consistency regularizer. Under stress testing PIRL's average accuracy drops by at most 1%, versus about 3% for GRPO.

items.title: PROSLEX: A Novel Dataset for Expert-Annotated Legal Statute Prediction for Indian Judiciary
items.title_zh: PROSLEX：面向印度司法体系的专家标注法律条文预测数据集
items.summary: PROSLEX contains 1,623 expert-annotated Indian legal documents paired with statute predictions and 7,450 explanations, and evaluates zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought and tree-of-thought prompting for both predictions and legal rationales. The benchmark scores explanation coherence and legal validity alongside predictive performance.

items.title: Theory-Guided Deception Detection: A RAG-Based Artificial Intelligence Exploration
items.title_zh: 理论引导的欺骗检测：基于 RAG 的人工智能探索
items.summary: Seven theory-grounded RAG models were compared with baselines across 700 statements, four LLMs and 39,200 deception judgments, yielding 54.5% accuracy for RAG versus 54.6% for baselines. RAG models were slightly less truth-biased, and theoretical perspective shifted response bias from 32.2% to 88.1% while barely affecting accuracy.

items.title: BOUND: Brief-Guided Corrective Preference Distillation at Search-Control Boundaries
items.title_zh: BOUND：搜索控制边界上的简报引导式纠偏偏好蒸馏
items.summary: BOUND targets persistent drift in LLM deep-search agents by having a teacher construct a search-state brief at student decision points and decide whether to form a corrective or termination preference pair, which DPO then distills into the student. items.title: Difficulty-Gated Fusion of Reasoning Views for Temporal Retrieval
items.title_zh: 面向时序检索的推理视图难度门控融合
items.summary: The method expands a query into several temporally explicit reformulations, reads an eight-dimensional score-distribution signature from each view, and uses a roughly one-thousand-parameter gate to set per-query fusion weights without relevance labels, re-ranking or retriever fine-tuning. It improves all six evaluated retrievers on the Tempo benchmark, with the strongest reaching 0.297 nDCG@10 and a per-query oracle at 0.364.

items.title: Not an A11y: How Android Accessibility Exposes Mobile AI Agents to Indirect Prompt Injection
items.title_zh: 并非无障碍：Android 无障碍服务如何使移动 AI 智能体面临间接提示注入
items.summary: The paper shows that mobile agent frameworks relying on Android accessibility trees and screenshots are systematically vulnerable to indirect prompt injection, causing goal hijacking, context drift and unauthorized device actions. Attack success reaches 0.822 for MobileRun with Gemma4:31B and 0.150 for Mobile-Use with Qwen3.6:35B, and the authors propose an attack taxonomy and zero-trust input validation.

items.title: Same Question, Different Answer? Measuring and Mitigating Prompt Privilege for Equitable AI Access
items.title_zh: 同样的问题，不同的答案？衡量并缓解提示特权以实现公平的 AI 访问
items.summary: The paper defines Prompt Privilege as performance disparities between semantically equivalent requests phrased differently, and introduces the Prompt Equity Score plus the Prompt Equity Transformer, an agent that rewrites requests into equivalent accessibility-oriented prompts. On MedQA, PET eliminated measurable disparities between low-literacy and expert-prompting cohorts while preserving semantic fidelity.

items.title: Leonxlnx/unlazy
items.title_zh: Leonxlnx/unlazy：对抗 AI 智能体惰性的技能
items.summary: unlazy is a skill aimed at countering AI-agent laziness through the Depth Tree method, which splits a task into layers and gives every leaf the whole task's time budget.
